cluster_reason: Tag, TagSet, and HtmlTagOptions form a cohesive subsystem that models tag metadata and options. They have strong internal links (Tag references TagSet and HtmlTagOptions; TagSet references Tag) and encapsulate related concerns that are not the core parsing/state-machine logic. Moving them together keeps package-private interactions internal to the cluster and isolates tag-model responsibilities from the central parser components.

blocks.goal: Move the Tag-related cluster (Tag, TagSet, HtmlTagOptions) to a dedicated subpackage to reduce responsibilities in org.jsoup.parser.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move Tag to the destination package.
Move TagSet to the destination package alongside Tag to preserve package-private interactions.
Move HtmlTagOptions to the destination package so tag configuration stays with tag model classes.
